Distribute Timers.name: Distribute Timers
Distribute Timers.description: Changes priorization of the process timers.

KeyboardDataQueueSize.name: KeyboardDataQueueSize
KeyboardDataQueueSize.description: reducing the keyboard events buffered by the keyboard driver, resulting in reducing latency.

MouseDataQueueSize.name: MouseDataQueueSize
MouseDataQueueSize.description: Reducing mouse events buffered by the mouse it's driver, resulting in reduced latency.

Threaded DPC.name: Threaded DPC
Threaded DPC.description: Reduces the general DPC latency increasing system responsiveness by forcing all DPC's to run asynchronously.

System Responsiveness.name: System Responsiveness
System Responsiveness.description: Reduces the amound of cpu usage reserved for background tasks, resulting in less interrupts and smoother frametimes.

Split Large Caches.name: Split Large Caches
Split Large Caches.description: Splits large caches into smaller chunks reducing overall system latency.

Network Throttling.name: Network Throttling
Network Throttling.description: Enables network throttling, optimizing network stability and speed.

General Kernel Tweaks.name: General Kernel Tweaks
General Kernel Tweaks.description: Bunch of kernel optimizations, optimizing kernel speeds.

DPC Optimizations.name: DPC Optimizations
DPC Optimizations.description: Optimized the dpc  (Deferred Process Call) scheduler.

Disable MMCSS.name: Disable MMCSS
Disable MMCSS.description: Disabling the multimedia class scheduler service can improve performance for (some) applications by disabling the priority set by MMCSS.

Enable Lazy Mode.name: Enable Lazy Mode
Enable Lazy Mode.description: Enables a lazy mode for the MMCSS scheduler. Reducing interrupts and system responsiveness.

Lazymode Timeout Tweak.name: Lazymode timeout tweak
Lazymode Timeout Tweak.description: This tweak can improve latency and stability, however it can occur that this tweak can cause stutters and instabilities. It modified the MMCSS cycle suspension between idle time periods.

Enable Lazymode.name: Enable Lazymode
Enable Lazymode.description: Enabled a lazy mode for the MMCSS scheduler.

Disable MMSCC Always On.name: Disable MMSCC Always On
Disable MMSCC Always On.description: Stops forcing MMCSS to be always on. This could improve stability, however it can also cause stuttering and unstable frametimes.

Disable Interrupt Steering.name: Disable Interrupt Steering
Disable Interrupt Steering.description: Disables the dynamic distribution of IRQ requests across cores. It forces each hardware device's interrupts to remain on its specifically assigned cores rather than letting Windows shift them around

Disable Distribute Timers.name: Disable Distribute Timers
Disable Distribute Timers.description: Disables the distribution of DPC's across multiple cores, disabling this will improve system latency and stability except when working with heavy multithreaded programs.

Disable NFTS Tunneling.name: Disable NFTS Tunneling
Disable NFTS Tunneling.description: Disables saving of temporary caches of programs, reducing overall interrupts.

Disable Event Processor.name: Disable Event Processor
Disable Event Processor.description: Disabling the event processor will disable windows it's power saving feature on the cpu. This will reduce overall latency.

DWM Flip Present.name: DWM Flip Present
DWM Flip Present.description: Cuts 1-2 frames of processing delay added by DWM composition and reduces overall input latency.

DWM Immediate render.name: DWM Immediate render
DWM Immediate render.description: Sets renderings to near zero milliseconds, removes visual processing and forces FIFO frame delivery. Though this tweak is quite risky and could freeze your system. Tweak made by Kizzmo.

DWM Adjustables.name: DWM Adjustables
DWM Adjustables.description: Optimized DWM's VRAM and GPU usage. Made by Jdallmann
